briefdescription.para: MCOperandNum - The corresponding MCInst operand number.

detaileddescription.para: Only valid when parsing MS-style inline assembly.

briefdescription.para: Constraint - The constraint on this operand.

detaileddescription.para: Only valid when parsing MS-style inline assembly.

briefdescription.para: isToken - Is this a token operand?
isImm - Is this an immediate operand?
isReg - Is this a register operand?
isMem - Is this a memory operand?

isMemUseUpRegs - Is memory operand use up regs, for example, intel MS inline asm may use ARR[baseReg + IndexReg + ...] which may use up regs in [...] expr, so ARR[baseReg + IndexReg + ...] can not use extra reg for ARR.

detaileddescription.para: For example, calculating ARR address to a reg or use another base reg in PIC model.

briefdescription.para: getStartLoc - Get the location of the first token of this operand.
getEndLoc - Get the location of the last token of this operand.
needAddressOf - Do we need to emit code to get the address of the variable/label?

detaileddescription.para: Only valid when parsing MS-style inline assembly.

briefdescription.para: isOffsetOfLocal - Do we need to emit code to get the offset of the local variable, rather than its value?

detaileddescription.para: Only valid when parsing MS-style inline assembly.

briefdescription.para: getOffsetOfLoc - Get the location of the offset operator.
print - Print a debug representation of the operand to the given stream.
dump - Print to the debug stream.
MCParsedAsmOperand - This abstract class represents a source-level assembly instruction operand.

detaileddescription.para: It should be subclassed by target-specific code. This base class is used by target-independent clients and is the interface between parsing an asm instruction and recognizing it.
